guide.summary: Museums, a cultural centre, a city viewpoint, a Maipo winery and Santiago restaurants, cafés, bakeries and bars, each checked against its own website.
guide.tip: Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes, Museo Nacional de Historia Natural, Museo Chileno de Arte Precolombino and Museo Interactivo Mirador are all closed on Mondays, so keep Monday for Sky Costanera, which opens daily from 10:00 to 22:00.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes, Museo Nacional de Historia Natural, Museo Chileno de Arte Precolombino and Museo Interactivo Mirador are closed on Mondays. Galindo is also closed on Mondays, and Liguria's Lastarria branch is closed on Sundays.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Sky Costanera tickets are valid only for the date and time bought, with sunset entry from 18:00 to 20:00 costing more. Concha y Toro tour bookings are non-refundable, though date changes are free with 24 hours' notice.

toolkit.label: Restaurant bookings
toolkit.copy: Boragó asks for a credit card number to book, holds tables for 30 minutes and may charge for no-shows. DeMo at Hotel Magnolia takes guests by prior booking only, with seatings at 19:00, 20:00 and 21:00, Tuesday to Saturday.

toolkit.label: Age and item rules
toolkit.copy: At Concha y Toro, under-18s can join the tour but cannot enter the tasting room. Boragó has no children's chairs or kids' menu, and Sky Costanera bans liquids, gels and aerosols.

guide.dek: Plan museum days from Tuesday to Sunday, and book Boragó, DeMo, Sky Costanera and any Concha y Toro tour ahead.
intro: Start in the centre, where several of the city's museums sit within walking distance. Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes, on José Miguel de la Barra, is free for everyone and opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 18:30. Its current shows include "Enrique Ramírez. Te creo paisaje", running to 28 February 2027, and "Roberto Matta. Abrir la mirada", which continues to 31 July 2027. A short walk away on Bandera, Museo Chileno de Arte Precolombino is closed on Mondays and is free on the first Sunday of each month for Chilean nationals and residents.

Centro Cultural La Moneda, under the Plaza de la Ciudadanía, opens its exhibitions Tuesday to Sunday from 10:15 to 18:45. "CASA COMÚN: 100 años de parques nacionales" runs to 6 December 2026, and the free "La ronda del Sol y la Luna" continues to May 2027. Across the river in Providencia, Neruda's house La Chascona follows the Fundación Pablo Neruda's March to December schedule of Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 to 18:00. For a view, Sky Costanera opens daily from 10:00 to 22:00, and tickets are valid only for the slot you buy.

With children, Museo Nacional de Historia Natural in Parque Quinta Normal is free and closed on Mondays. "Mariposas y Polillas, Colores en Movimiento" runs there to 3 January 2027. Museo Interactivo Mirador in La Granja is also closed on Mondays and opens only until 13:30 on Tuesdays. At Teatro Municipal on Agustinas, the season lists "Elektra" from 17 to 29 November and the family ballet "Clarita y su amigo Cascanueces" from 12 to 19 December. For a day out of town, Concha y Toro's Centro del Vino in Pirque sells timed tours online.

For food, Boragó in Vitacura opens Tuesday to Saturday from 17:15 and needs a credit card to book. DeMo at Hotel Magnolia serves tasting menus by booking only, and the hotel's seventh-floor Terraza Magnolia looks onto Cerro Santa Lucía. In Lastarria, Bocanáriz is a wine bar and shop, and Liguria on Merced opens Monday to Saturday. For a cheaper lunch, try Fuente Mardoqueo on Libertad, open daily from 12:00 to 23:00. In the morning, Café Altura on Manuel Montt opens at 8:00 on weekdays, and Castaño on the Alameda opens at 08:00 on weekdays.
summaryCards: Pair Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes and Museo Chileno de Arte Precolombino on any day from Tuesday to Sunday, then book a Sky Costanera slot for the view.
Start with coffee at Café Altura on Manuel Montt from 8:00 on weekdays, then walk to La Chascona, open Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00.
Boragó needs a credit card to reserve, Concha y Toro tours are non-refundable, and the main museums here are closed on Mondays.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several official sites could not be read: Parque Metropolitano (Cerro San Cristóbal) refused connections, Mercado Central, La Vega Central, Viña Santa Rita, Mestizo, Mulato and others failed DNS lookup, Tren al Sur had a certificate error, MAC returned 403 and Cousiño Macul returned 429; these are not evidence of closure. Museo Histórico Nacional's own site says it is temporarily closed for expansion. Published information was partial for some places: Museo Chileno de Arte Precolombino's general weekly hours were on a tab not readable, Bocanáriz and Terraza Magnolia publish no hours, Emporio La Rosa (Merced) lists no Saturday hours, and La Chascona's page gives a March to December schedule without listing ticket prices. Several restaurant and café entries (Liguria, Galindo, Ambrosía Bistro, Castaño, Tavelli, Fuente Mardoqueo) rest on live booking links, published hours or a 2026 copyright footer rather than dated announcements.
